name: Salt Lake Sector V Metro Station
observed: Long flat-roofed station block with light-grey square panel cladding, a broad peach band, repeated dark rectangular windows, an open ground-level parking/entrance zone on concrete piers, pale vertical end cores, thin blue roof-edge trim and the bilingual Salt Lake Sector V name on the near core.

approach.observed: Street Number 11 is an undivided two-way approach with blue-white kerbs, paved footpaths, mature trees, black ornamental fencing, roadside food stalls and carts, slim lamps and the elevated viaduct crossing the junction ahead.

unverified: Interior, roof equipment, rear service elevation and exact height. The OSM footprint and existing long-axis alignment are retained.
